data.question: Why was FCRM-2026-0151 routed to committee instead of closed by the analyst?

sentences.text: The composite residual was first computed at 9.8, Band 2, which would have closed under delegated authority.
The boundary flag was raised because 9.8 sits 0.3 below the Band 3 edge.
The critic flagged the vendor due-diligence rating of 7.6 as 2.7 above the precedent average of 4.9, with evidence limited to a 2023 domestic-scope audit.
Analyst Rahul Iyer overrode the rating to 4.5 with the reason “audit predates the corridor arrangement”.
The engine recomputed to 10.4, Band 3, which routes to committee under routing rules v4.
The band change and boundary flag were acknowledged.
The committee approved with conditions by 2 to 1.
